title: The letter
steps: Some weeks ago a letter came to you: the invitation to your first year at Arvelia, signed by the head of the school, Orla. A huge castle was drawn on it.
It is this very castle, the castle of Arvelia, the school for young wizards, boys and girls. It stands high on a hill above a deep lake, and as you see it, you feel a great thrill.
Since you packed your bags, you have come a long way. Finally, past the village at the foot of the hill and up the steep climb at dusk, you have arrived.
Now you stand before the great iron gate. It is shut tight, with no handle and no bell, and you have no idea how to get in. But it is very quiet, almost as if it were listening.
Before the story goes on, just one question: who are you?
